title: The Crypto Graduate by Stanford Blockchain Club
author: Stanford Blockchain Club
description: Welcome to the Crypto Graduate Podcast by the Stanford Blockchain Club. In this graduate level podcast we hear the personal journeys of the builders, thinkers, and doers in crypto. We learn why they started in crypto, and what they did to graduate from crypto student to crypto leader. Let’s get started! Music: Spacedman by Shane Ivers Logo: Joshua Lucas @shualucas_
